rounds.title: Reverse Prompting
rounds.subtitle: Target Reconstruction & System Intent Extraction
rounds.description: Analyze a complex synthetic AI output and reverse-engineer the exact system prompt, constraints, role framing, and formatting directives needed to reproduce it deterministically.
rounds.instructions: Examine the target benchmark output below. Construct a single comprehensive prompt that instructs an LLM to generate output matching the structure, tone, constraints, and specific technical parameters of the target output without extraneous conversational filler.
rounds.qualificationRules: Top 70% of scoring participants qualify for Round 2. Minimum score: 60/100.

rounds.title: Prompt Compression
rounds.subtitle: Extreme Token Economy & Lossless Distillation
rounds.description: Distill a sprawling 1,200-word enterprise requirement document into a hyper-condensed prompt under 180 words while retaining 100% of functional requirements and negative constraints.
rounds.instructions: Given the extensive specification for a distributed microservice audit logger, engineer a high-density prompt strictly under 180 words/tokens that produces the exact required output schema without losing a single edge-case handling constraint.
rounds.qualificationRules: Top 50% of participants qualify for Round 3. Strict token ceiling enforced.

rounds.title: Prompt Relay
rounds.subtitle: Context Serialization & Zero-Drift Intermediate Handoff
rounds.description: Architect a sequence of 3 interconnected prompts where the structured output of Stage 1 cleanly feeds Stage 2 and culminates in Stage 3 without hallucination or contextual degradation.
rounds.instructions: Design a 3-stage relay pipeline: Stage 1 (Data Decomposition), Stage 2 (Analytical Synthesis), and Stage 3 (Actionable Decision Matrix). Your submission must define the prompt templates and handoff token contracts.
rounds.qualificationRules: Top 15 finalists qualify for the Championship Round 4.

rounds.title: Upskilling — Prompt Chaining
rounds.subtitle: Dynamic Agentic Orchestration & Verification Loops
rounds.description: Engineer a master multi-step prompt chain with automated self-critique, deterministic rollback on schema violations, and adaptive tool-routing instructions.
rounds.instructions: Construct an autonomous prompt chain designed for a real-time cybersecurity incident response system. The chain must handle triage, forensic synthesis, and containment action generation with explicit self-verification gates.
rounds.qualificationRules: Top 3 podium winners determined by cumulative championship score.

challenges.title: Target Architecture Deconstruction: Resilient Distributed Cache
challenges.taskOverview: Reverse-engineer the prompt that generated the high-precision technical specification below.
challenges.detailedTask: Below is an excerpt from a verified target LLM output specifying a Fault-Tolerant Distributed Cache Engine with exact YAML configuration schema, latency SLAs (<1.2ms p99), and quorum policies. Your goal is to write the system prompt that reproduces this output structure, semantic fidelity, and constraint compliance without hallucinating arbitrary extra commentary.
challenges.targetScenario:
TARGET BENCHMARK OUTPUT:
```yaml
system: HyperCache-v4
architecture:
  topology: hybrid-raft-ring
  node_capacity_gib: 64
  replication_factor: 3
  read_consistency: eventual_bounded_150ms
  write_consistency: quorum_strict
benchmarks:
  p95_read_latency_ms: 0.8
  p99_write_latency_ms: 1.15
  max_tps_per_node: 45000
failover:
  heartbeat_interval_ms: 200
  leader_election_timeout_ms: 600
  degradation_mode: read_only_stale_allowed
```
TASK: Write the system prompt that will instruct an AI to generate an identically formatted, rigorous distributed architecture specification for any high-throughput memory engine.
inputConstraints: Submission must be a complete, self-contained prompt.
Must specify strict YAML format requirement with no preamble or markdown fences inside the response.
Must enforce explicit SLA numbers and failover timeout properties.
Must instruct the model to adopt the persona of a Principal Distributed Systems Architect.

rubric.description: Clarity of role framing, domain expertise level, and task directive.
Explicit directives enforcing exact schema structure and preventing conversational fluff.
Completeness of latency metrics, quorum requirements, and failover constraints.
How reliably the prompt produces deterministic, zero-drift results across runs.

challenges.sampleInput: Memory Engine Type: Distributed Key-Value Store with Raft consensus
challenges.expectedOutputFormat: Pure YAML key-value hierarchy matching specification schema
challenges.hiddenExpectedAnswerOrCriteria: A high-scoring prompt specifies: Persona (Principal Systems Architect), Format Directive (Respond ONLY with valid YAML, no introductory text), Exact Keys (topology, node_capacity_gib, replication_factor, latency SLAs, failover parameters), and Negative Constraints (Zero conversational filler).
challenges.aiEvaluationSystemPrompt: Evaluate the student prompt on how effectively it reverse-engineers the target architecture output. Score out of 100 based on the 4 rubric criteria.

challenges.title: Enterprise Audit Gateway Specification Compression
challenges.taskOverview: Compress a comprehensive 1,200-word enterprise security compliance prompt into under 180 words.
challenges.detailedTask: An enterprise financial auditing service needs an automated prompt to review transaction payloads. The raw specification document spans 1,200 words covering SOC2 Type II compliance, PII masking (regex for credit cards/SSNs), multi-currency validation, and cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Compress this into an ultra-dense, unambiguous prompt under 180 words that maintains 100% constraint satisfaction.
challenges.targetScenario:
RAW SPECIFICATION HIGHLIGHTS:
- Mask all 16-digit PANs with format "XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234"
- Redact Tax IDs (SSN/EIN) completely to "[REDACTED]"
- Reject any transaction exceeding $100,000 without 2FA biometric token flag
- Output strictly RFC-7946 GeoJSON + JSON-LD audit log
- Return HTTP 400 for unverified HMAC signature.
inputConstraints: Strict length limit: Maximum 180 words (enforced by submission counter).
Must retain all 5 core security & formatting constraints.
No loss of semantic fidelity or schema rules.

rubric.description: Staying strictly under 180 words with minimal lexical redundancy.
Accurate preservation of all 5 critical enterprise audit constraints.
Use of high-density technical syntax, shorthand, and direct notation.

challenges.hiddenExpectedAnswerOrCriteria: Target compressed prompt leverages dense imperative syntax, compact regex definitions, and clear output spec while honoring the 180-word ceiling.
challenges.aiEvaluationSystemPrompt: Analyze word count strictly. If word count > 180, deduct 20 points. Evaluate constraint preservation and density.

challenges.title: Tri-Stage Prompt Relay: Financial Anomaly Forensic Pipeline
challenges.taskOverview: Design a 3-stage prompt relay pipeline where output of Stage 1 directly drives Stage 2, which feeds Stage 3.
challenges.detailedTask: Develop an end-to-end prompt relay system for suspicious transaction analysis. Stage 1 extracts anomalous vectors from raw logs. Stage 2 computes risk scores and correlation clusters. Stage 3 drafts the formal Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) for regulatory submission. Clearly define the prompt for each stage and the intermediate JSON schema bridge.
challenges.targetScenario: Input: Unstructured core banking transaction logs with timestamps, IP addresses, geolocations, and wire amounts.
inputConstraints: Must define Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 prompts.
Must define the exact JSON payload contract between Stage 1 -> Stage 2 and Stage 2 -> Stage 3.
Must include error-handling directive for ambiguous data.

rubric.description: Completeness and robustness of JSON handoff schemas between stages.
Guarantees against drift, loss of original data, or hallucinated facts.
Fidelity of forensic risk scoring and SAR reporting logic.

challenges.hiddenExpectedAnswerOrCriteria: Complete 3-prompt sequence with explicit markdown/JSON delimiter tags for reliable machine consumption.
challenges.aiEvaluationSystemPrompt: Evaluate the multi-stage relay pipeline. Verify that intermediate data formats match between stages.

challenges.title: Autonomous Cybersecurity Incident Remediation Chain
challenges.taskOverview: Build an advanced multi-step prompt chain with self-critique, deterministic rollback, and verification loops.
challenges.detailedTask: Design a comprehensive prompt orchestration chain for zero-day vulnerability containment. The system must autonomously triage threat intelligence, synthesize firewall/kernel patch commands, test the patch in a virtual simulation check, verify zero business disruption, and trigger automatic rollback if side-effects are detected.
challenges.targetScenario: Target incident: Active CVE exploitation attempting memory corruption on edge load balancers.
inputConstraints: Must specify triage step, containment generation, validation loop, and rollback trigger.
Must incorporate self-critique prompt with explicit pass/fail threshold.
Must include a human-in-the-loop authorization gate before production execution.

rubric.description: Elegance and resilience of automated self-critique and validation loops.
Deterministic rollback triggers, simulation isolation, and guardrails.
Precision of prompt directives, negative prompts, and edge-case handling.

challenges.hiddenExpectedAnswerOrCriteria: Full prompt chaining specification with cycle limits to prevent infinite loops, schema validations, and fallback states.
challenges.aiEvaluationSystemPrompt: Score the prompt chaining architecture based on loop safety, self-verification rigor, and rollback mechanics.

submissions.promptSubmission: You are a Principal Distributed Systems Architect. Generate an ultra-strict YAML configuration for HyperCache-v4 with raft-ring topology, replication factor 3, quorum strict write consistency, bounded eventual read consistency under 150ms, read SLA p95 < 0.8ms, write SLA p99 < 1.15ms, and 200ms failover heartbeats. Output strictly valid YAML with no preamble, conversational text, or markdown code fences.
submissions.feedback: Evaluation completed successfully against official rubric criteria (92/100).

criterionScores.comment: Strict YAML output constraint unambiguously declared.
Covers latency SLAs, quorum and failover constraints.
